name: shellbridge
description: Give ChatGPT fast, safe, and auditable visibility into a Linux VPS through MCP

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p dist/native && cc -std=c17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror native/shellbridge-helper.c -o dist/native/shellbridge-helper && dist/native/shellbridge-helper write-seccomp dist/native/network-deny.bpf
scripts.test:core: SHELLBRIDGE_TEST_FAKE_SANDBOX=1 vitest run test/api.test.ts test/git.test.ts --testTimeout=15000 --hookTimeout=15000 --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false && SHELLBRIDGE_TEST_FAKE_SANDBOX=1 vitest run test/capabilities.test.ts --testTimeout=15000 --hookTimeout=15000 --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false && vitest run test/config-inspector.test.ts test/config.test.ts test/policy.test.ts test/sandboxed-shell.test.ts --testTimeout=15000 --hookTimeout=15000 --pool=threads --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false
scripts.check: npm run test:core && npm run build
